intro: The Osiris unit is designed to showcase what you love. Its backlit shelves, sleek glass panels, and durable build make it the perfect mix of beauty and function—fitting effortlessly into any décor.

features.title: Backlit shelves to highlight your collection
features.text: Built-in LED lighting brings a soft glow to your books and décor, making every item stand out while adding warmth to your space.

features.title: Premium engineered wood for lasting durability
features.text: Made from high-quality engineered wood, our unit is strong, resistant to wear, and built to handle everyday use without losing its charm.

features.title: Toughened glass for safety and style
features.text: Shatter-resistant glass panels protect your books and décor while giving the unit a polished, modern look that enhances your home.

features.title: Easy to maintain for everyday convenience
features.text: Dust-resistant surfaces and sturdy materials make cleaning effortless, so your display always looks as stunning as the day you set it up.

features.title: Neutral tones that fit any décor
features.text: Soft, earthy hues complement both modern and classic interiors, ensuring this unit blends seamlessly into your home.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
